tbesh_html:
1) all, the whole
1a) all, the whole of
1b) any, each, every, anything
1c) totality, everything
Aramaic equivalent: kol (כֹּל "all" H3606)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, the whole; hence, all, any or every (in the singular only, but often in a plural sense)
strongs_1890.kjv_def: (in) all (manner, (ye)), altogether, any (manner), enough, every (one, place, thing), howsoever, as many as, (no-) thing, ought, whatsoever, (the) whole, whoso(-ever).
